stem.text: The diagram shows pressure changes in the left side of the heart and aorta over time. The length of this cardiac cycle is $0.6\,\text{s}$. Points 1, 2, 3 and 4 indicate when atrioventricular valves and semilunar valves either open or close.

stem.alt: Graph of pressure in kPa against time in s for the left ventricle, aorta and left atrium, with a key and points 1 to 4 marked by numbered arrows.
